questions.cardDe: Der längste Fluss Deutschlands fließt von West nach Ost. Richtig oder falsch?
questions.de: Welcher Fluss hat innerhalb Deutschlands die längste Fließstrecke?
questions.en: Which river has the longest course within Germany?

timeline.labelEn: The first continuous length survey of the Rhine is completed
timeline.labelDe: Die erste durchgehende Längenvermessung des Rheins wird abgeschlossen

questions.notes: Card's true/false statement reworked to an open question. The Rhine runs 865 km in Germany (the Danube 647 km) and flows mainly south to north, so the statement is false for it; only the Danube, the longest river overall that crosses Germany (2,857 km), flows west to east — the card is ambiguous.

timeline.labelDe: Andrew Smith beschreibt den Walhai (Rhincodon typus) wissenschaftlich

questions.notes: Card asked which of bottlenose dolphin / beluga / whale shark is not a whale (the whale shark); reworked to an open question. It is a carpet shark (Orectolobiformes), a cartilaginous fish.

questions.notes: Strictly the team is the New Zealand national rugby union team; 'All Blacks' is its nickname, used as its brand.
